checks: Actual milestone creation rejects invalid dates without a request; exact Hong Kong time, owner, microseconds, missed state and versioned editing persist.
Milestone achievement refuses missing evidence without mutation, succeeds after an original completed associated task and supports exact reopen/cancel commands.
Actual risk creation, revision, closure and reopening preserve optional probability, show mitigation, prevent false date clearing and retain text on a real concurrent 409.
A committed risk realization with a lost response blocks replay, creates exactly one real issue and exposes its actual link even when probability is unset.
The actual linked issue follows investigation, resolution, closure and reopening; empty resolution sends no request and the original solution persists.
Direct issue creation and editing use the original commands, preserve absent deadlines and keep editing separate from an explicit state decision.
A real accessible item from another project cannot open an editing form under the wrong project and remains unchanged.
Real membership restriction invalidates the old login; fresh MFA viewer and cancelled-project manager cannot create, edit or follow state-changing deep links.
